title: Boundary IoU: Improving Object-Centric Image Segmentation Evaluation
mechanism: IoU restricted to a band of width d around both contours; more sensitive to boundary quality on large objects.
adaptation: Use for inactive and large structural classes; for 1-2 px cracks Boundary IoU at d >= 2 equals mask IoU, so no use for crack.
min_experiment: Arm: Boundary IoU d=3 for inactive, gridline, busbar on OOF. Kill: never changes a ranking vs mask IoU.
evidence: R: more sensitive than mask IoU to boundary errors on large objects on COCO, LVIS, Cityscapes.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark scoring: Boundary IoU at d = 2 px for inactive and structural classes beside IoU; for crack it is close to relF1@2 and gives it a published name; Boundary PQ if an instance view is adopted.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training: rescore existing house and PF predictions on val/CV folds with Boundary IoU d = 1, 2, 3 and check rank agreement with relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark scoring: report Boundary IoU at d = 2 px for inactive and the structural classes next to IoU. For crack it is close to our relaxed metric and gives that metric a published, citable name.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training. Recompute on existing house / PF predictions on val folds and check that model rankings stay stable across seeds.
